ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel distribution concentrated in focal marks and scars.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark base across both lobes; sparse, non-contiguous high-contrast white focal points and rings (0.5% to 2% surface area each) distributed randomly across the medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 45-degree acute V-shaped notch; central depression depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 2-10 pixels; significant non-symmetrical indentation on the left lobe trailing edge adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to high-aspect-ratio pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters localized at the extreme lateral tips (distal corners) and scattered as singular units across the mid-lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-aligned linear pixel disruptions (scratches) of varying lengths (10-100 pixels) crisscrossing both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch/missing segment on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately 100 pixels from the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense white calcified clusters (barnacles) localized specifically on the leading and trailing edges of the extreme lateral tips.
